name: Doleman Kou
source: Director of the National Research and Development Institute of Eldia, he was the foremost authority on human cloning technology. He created the "Doll" Series of human clones, the µ101 prototype, the "Rhaima" human growth acceleration technology, the "Positronic Brain," pioneering techniques for human memory transfer and digitalization. Before being killed by his son, Stoleman, he transferred his own memories into his own creation, the "Doll" series.
